title: ozw's acceptance criteria parse as one item again: [A2]..[A5] are mid-line
description:
internal/acceptance's parser takes a [A<n>] mark only at a line's start, and .tick/issues/ozw.json carries its five criteria on one line, so the epic's definition of done has exactly one item of record (A1) — the same defect the ymf review filed low, recurring, and the run has not applied the tracker edit. This review's blocking finding breaks the committed-screenshots clause of [A3] and [A5]'s 'screenshots updated', but breaks.item cannot name them, so it carries no claim a machine can key on. The fix is a tracker edit — re-mark the criteria one item per line — which is the run's to apply.
evidence: .tick/issues/ozw.json acceptance_criteria (one line, [A1]..[A5]); internal/acceptance/acceptance.go:18 (attemptedMark is line-anchored)
